model.title: A resolution expressing support for the designation of October 4 through October 10, 2026, as "National 4-H Week".

summary.text: The resolution would express Congressional support for designating the week of October 4 through October 10, 2026, as "National 4-H Week" to recognize the organization's youth development programs and contributions to American communities.
